paragraphs: I'm an electrical engineering student at the University of Oklahoma. I grew up in Laos, finished high school at Li Po Chun United World College in Hong Kong, and started at OU in engineering physics. I switched to electrical engineering because I enjoy learning how devices like MOSFETs actually work, and I wanted to build things with them.

Now I split my time between boards and the cleanroom: I design the power distribution board for our robotics team and fabricate micro- and nanostructures in the PLATEN lab. On this site I write up each project: what it had to do, the choices I made, and what I'd change.
